reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. With our new native sparse CA system, water depth is now accurately represented in real-time without freezing the frame. You can shape the ground by raising lips or digging ditches, and the water will respond accordingly. Check out the full details on our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: New Water Mechanics in Provincia!
steam.body: We're thrilled to share that we've improved the water mechanics in Provincia! With our latest update, the water now reacts dynamically to terrain changes without any lag or freezing. You can raise lips, dig ditches, and the water will respond in real-time. For a detailed look at these changes, visit our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
